biology: Host records include Dabie Mountains pine (Pinus dabeshanensis) and bald cypress (Taxodium distichum).
soldier: Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.66, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frons flat, slightly concave between the peaks. Labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the apex narrowly angular but not sharply pointed; labral setae well developed, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles slender and pointed at the apex, slightly curved and slightly upturned; length 0.54–0.58 of head capsule length and 0.85–0.91 of head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior quarter, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region slightly broad, its sides nearly broadly arcuate, waist constriction index 0.37–0.46. Pronotum somewhat kidney-shaped, 1.53–1.77 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, posterior margin shallowly concave to incised in the middle; more than 10 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
